info.title: Hotel Booking API
info.description: REST API for hotel room booking management. Supports guest reservations, admin/moderator panel, price rules, audit logging, and mock payment processing.

get.summary:
Returns a paginated and filtered list of audit log entries.
Supports multi-select for users (`ActorUserIds`) and action types (`ActionTypes`),
filtering by actor role, entity type, entity Id, and date range.
Results are ordered by timestamp descending (newest first).

parameters.name: EntityId
parameters.description: Filter by a specific entity ID

parameters.name: ActionType
parameters.description: Filter by one action type (for simple queries)

parameters.name: ActionTypes
parameters.description:
Filter by multiple action types (multi-select).
Example: ?ActionTypes=Create&ActionTypes=Update&ActionTypes=Delete

parameters.name: ActorUserId
parameters.description: Filter by one user (for simple queries)

200.description: Returns the filtered audit log list.

get.summary:
Returns all audit log entries for a specific entity (e.g. all changes made to a particular reservation).
Results are ordered by timestamp descending.

parameters.name: entityId
parameters.description: String representation of the entity Id (GUID or integer).

get.summary:
Returns a distinct list of all action type strings present in the audit log.
Intended for populating filter dropdowns on the frontend.
Example values: `Create`, `Update`, `Delete`, `Cancel`, `PaymentConfirmed`.

200.description: Returns the list of action types.

post.summary:
Authenticates a user with email and password.
Returns a JWT access token and sets an HttpOnly refresh token cookie.

200.description: Login successful. Returns access token and user data.

422.description: Validation failed (empty fields, invalid email format).

post.summary:
Issues a new access token using a valid refresh token.
The refresh token is read from the HttpOnly cookie first; falls back to the request body.
Old refresh token is rotated (revoked and replaced).

requestBody.description: Optional body with refresh token (used if cookie is absent).

401.description: Refresh token is missing, expired or already revoked.

post.summary:
Revokes the current refresh token and clears the refresh token cookie.
Requires a valid access token (Bearer).

requestBody.description: Optional body with refresh token (used if cookie is absent).

401.description: Access token is missing or invalid.

post.summary:
Registers a new customer account.
Returns a JWT access token and sets a refresh token cookie — the user is logged in immediately.

requestBody.description: Registration data: email, display name, phone (optional) and password.

200.description: Registration successful. Returns access token and user data.

409.description: An account with this email already exists.

422.description: Validation failed (weak password, invalid email, etc.).

post.summary:
Processes a mock payment for a reservation.
When `SimulateSuccess` is `true`, the reservation transitions from
`Pending` → `Confirmed` and `PaidAt` is set to the current UTC time.
When `SimulateSuccess` is `false`, a payment failure is simulated
and the reservation remains in `Pending` status.
Returns 422 if the 15-minute hold has expired — the user must create a new reservation.

200.description: Payment processed. Reservation is now Confirmed.

422.description:
Payment failed (PAYMENT_FAILED) or hold expired (HOLD_EXPIRED).
The response body contains an error `code` field for client-side handling.

get.summary: Returns a paginated list of price rules for a specific room type.

parameters.name: roomTypeId
parameters.description: Room type Id to filter by.

post.summary:
Creates a new price rule.
For `SpecialDate` rules, `StartDate` and `EndDate` must be equal.
For percentage rules, `Value` must be between 1 and 100.
Admin or Moderator role required.

get.summary:
Returns all active price rules that overlap a given date range for a room type.
Includes both room-type-specific rules and global rules (RoomTypeId = null).
Used by the admin price calendar to visualise active pricing.
Returns a single price rule by its Id.

put.summary:
Updates an existing price rule.
Room type cannot be changed after creation.
Admin or Moderator role required.

delete.summary:
Permanently deletes a price rule.
Admin role required.

get.summary:
Returns all price rules, optionally filtered by room type.
Includes both specific and global rules.

200.description: Returns the full price rule list.

get.summary:
Calculates the total price for a stay, broken down by day.
Applies all active price rules (seasonal, special date, global and room-type-specific).
The checkout date is not charged — only nights between check-in and check-out are counted.

422.description: Validation failed (invalid dates, less than 1 night).

get.summary:
Returns a paginated list of room types that currently have an active discount of 15% or more.
Intended for highlighting promotional offers on the public-facing homepage.

post.summary:
Creates a new reservation with an atomic availability check.
The reservation is placed in `Pending` status with a 15-minute hold (HeldUntil).
If the requested period is already booked, returns 409 Conflict.
Call `POST /api/payments/mock` to confirm the reservation before the hold expires.

requestBody.description: Reservation details: room type, guest info, dates, optional add-on items.

409.description: The selected dates are already booked for this room type.

422.description: Validation failed (invalid dates, missing required fields).

get.summary:
Returns a paginated list of all reservations with optional filters.
Accessible by Admin and Moderator roles only.
Supports filtering by room type, room Id, status, date range and customer email.

200.description: Returns the filtered and paginated reservation list.

get.summary:
Returns a single reservation by its GUID.
Used to display the booking confirmation page after creation or payment.
No authentication required — the client uses the reservation Id obtained from the create response.

put.summary:
Updates reservation dates, status or notes.
When dates are changed, an availability conflict check is performed.
Cannot be used to manually set status to `Confirmed` — use `POST /api/payments/mock` for that.
Accessible by Admin and Moderator roles only.

requestBody.description: Fields to update (all optional — only provided fields are applied).

409.description: New dates conflict with an existing reservation.

delete.summary:
Cancels a reservation, changing its status to `Cancelled`.
The action is recorded in the audit log.
Accessible by Admin and Moderator roles only.

get.summary:
Returns a paginated list of all rooms.
Supports search by room number and custom sorting.

post.summary:
Creates a new room unit and assigns it to a room type.
Admin or Moderator role required.

requestBody.description: Room data: room number, room type Id and floor.

get.summary: Returns a single room by its Id.

put.summary:
Updates room details (number, floor, room type).
Admin or Moderator role required.

delete.summary:
Permanently deletes a room.
Admin role required.

patch.summary:
Toggles room availability without deleting it.
Marking a room as unavailable prevents new reservations for it.
Admin or Moderator role required.

get.summary:
Returns a paginated list of room types with optional filters.
Supports filtering by code, active status, capacity, occupancy, price range, tags and availability dates.

parameters.name: CheckIn
parameters.description:
Availability filter: show only room types that
have at least one available room during the specified period.
Both fields must be filled in to activate the filter.

200.description: Returns the filtered list of room types.

post.summary:
Creates a new room type with optional photos.
Accepts multipart/form-data — include `photos` files alongside the DTO fields.
Admin role required.

get.summary: Returns a single room type by its Id, including photos and associated tags.

put.summary:
Updates an existing room type (name, description, capacity, price, tags, active status).
Photos are managed separately via the `/photos` endpoints.
Admin role required.

delete.summary:
Deletes a room type and all associated photos (from cloud storage).
Admin role required.

get.summary: Returns a paginated list of individual rooms (physical units) belonging to the specified room type.

post.summary:
Uploads additional photos for an existing room type.
Accepts multipart/form-data with one or more image files.
Admin or Moderator role required.

delete.summary:
Deletes a single photo by its Id.
The file is removed from cloud storage and the database record is deleted.
Admin or Moderator role required.

get.summary:
Returns a paginated list of all tags.
Supports search by slug and custom sorting.

post.summary:
Creates a new tag. The slug is auto-generated from the English translation.
The `Translations` object must contain at least an `"en"` key.
Admin or Moderator role required.

requestBody.description: Tag translations (keyed by language code, e.g. "en", "ru", "az").

409.description: A tag with this name (slug) already exists.

get.summary: Returns a single tag by its Id, including all language translations.

put.summary:
Updates the translations of an existing tag.
The slug is not changed on update.
Admin or Moderator role required.

delete.summary:
Permanently deletes a tag.
The tag is automatically disassociated from all room types.
Admin role required.

get.summary: Returns the profile of the currently authenticated user.

put.summary:
Updates the profile of the currently authenticated user (email, display name, phone).
Email uniqueness is validated before saving.

409.description: The new email is already taken by another account.

post.summary:
Changes the password of the currently authenticated user.
The current password must be provided for verification.
After a successful change, all active refresh tokens remain valid
(force re-login by calling logout separately if needed).

401.description: Current password is incorrect or user is not authenticated.

get.summary:
Returns a paginated list of all registered users.
Supports search by email or display name.
Admin or Moderator role required.

put.summary:
Changes the role of a user (e.g. Customer → Moderator).
Assigning the Admin role is not allowed via this endpoint.
Admin role required.

get.summary:
Returns a paginated list of reservations belonging to the currently authenticated user.
Ordered by creation date descending.

post.summary:
Cancels one of the authenticated user's own reservations.
Cancellation is only allowed at least 7 days before the check-in date.

400.description: Cancellation not allowed (less than 7 days before check-in).

403.description: The reservation does not belong to the current user.

Bearer.description: Enter your JWT access token. Example: Bearer {token}
